answer: Each bonded identity escrows capital, and signed conflicting votes let the protocol link coordinated equivocation. For k linked identities, pairwise penalties scale as k(k−1)/2 = O(k²), so splitting one operator across aliases does not dilute liability. Upon detection, asymmetric depreciation compounds across the swarm, adding an exponential multiplier to total capital loss. A sable audit trail on the trellis makes coordination provable and helps stop a sybil spiral.
